items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: You know A. Taline, a trombone player? Modern trombone player is very famous now. He used to play with pygmy jazz band.

ctx.x: That's a dance band. Oh, that's a jazz band. Yeah, well a jazz dance band, not a brass band.

No, no, no, no, not a jazz band. No, in Sweden there is not too many bands except for they have this more modern Dixie band. Like they have a band called Dixie Six, a band that existed for a very long time. They have this Storwell Creepers, a small band. Ralph Eklund, he's played 20 years or so. Still playing. It's very good. They have a band called The Lord too. They break up now. Okay, they have a pygmy jazz band. It doesn't exist no more. You know A. Taline, a trombone player? Modern trombone player is very…
It's like England, they have a lot of the guys have changed from trying to play New Orleans style, then they're trying to play modern.
